question: What is the percentage of players that are under 180 cm who have an overall strength of more than 70?

answer: ## 结论 **13.9408%**（约 13.94%）的球员身高低于 180 cm 且综合评分（overall rating）高于 70。 ### 语义锚定过程 | 层级 | 工具 | 结果 | |------|------|------| | L1 数据源级 | `dlr_semantic_query` | 命中
sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.height < 180 AND T2.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id), 4) AS pct FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player
